summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Next Day Disclosure Return (Hong Kong equivalent of a Form 6-K) detailing share buybacks and a small RSU settlement. From March 20 to April 13, 2026, it repurchased approximately 11.8 million Class A ordinary shares for cancellation at prices between $6.57 and $6.82 per share (total ~$78M). Additionally, 20,000 new shares were issued on May 26 for vesting of restricted share units at $0. No premium or tender offer involved; the buybacks are open-market. The board supports this capital return program. Watch for continued repurchase pace and eventual cancellation timing.
